title: Platform
description:
The DroMii platform provides a wide range of spatial data and analytics services based on drone imagery.
It allows users to easily access and utilize spatial insights anytime, anywhere.

section1.title: Drone as a Service
section1.description:
Build spatial data using 3D models and panoramic outputs generated from drone imagery,
and conveniently access analysis results and reports through shareable URLs.

section2.title: DaaS 3D
section2.description:
Upload images to the platform using a simple drag-and-drop interface to automatically generate 3D spatial data.
All processes are automated through distributed network-based processing, providing various data analytics and reporting capabilities.

section3.title: DaaS Pano (360°)
section3.description: Through automated processing including mosaicking and color correction, the 360° panoramic platform generates real-time results and delivers HTML5-based outputs accessible across devices and operating systems.

section1.title: Drone Traffic Mapper / Drone to Mapper
section1.description:
DTM is a spatial data solution that utilizes various sensors mounted on drones
to collect and analyze aerial, water surface, and ground data.

section2.title: DTM ML
section2.description:
By applying machine learning to drone imagery analysis, various types of spatial data can be generated.
Beyond the limitations of traditional equipment, drones can efficiently capture both bidirectional and full-lane road information.

section3.title: DTM AI
section3.description: By combining drones, artificial intelligence, and big data technologies, DTM supports condition-based monitoring and analysis of various infrastructure assets. It also enables seamless integration with existing management systems.

section3.title: CfSM
section3.subtitle: Car-free Street Mapping
section3.description:
CfSM utilizes deep learning algorithms to automatically remove vehicles from road imagery and generate clean, car-free street maps.
This data can be used for autonomous driving simulations or for building high-definition safety maps (HDS Map) for road safety analysis.

section4.title: AfGG
section4.subtitle: Auto-labeling 5G Geo-spatial Information HDS Map
section4.description1:
AfGG is a solution that generates HDS (High-Definition Safety) Maps based on road marking information.
Using DTM ML technology, it automatically labels road markings such as lane lines, crosswalks, and stop lines,
and detects risk factors like potholes and cracks to collect comprehensive road information.
section4.description2:
Through this technology, DroMii can build high-precision maps that include
various road markings and risk factors focused on improving vehicle safety.

section5.title: 3D Modeling
section5.description:
Uploads the images taken for building 3D spatial data to the platform with simple 'drag & drop'.
The whole process automated with a parallel processing-based network provides various data analysis and reports
